decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to use Oath of Druids to cheat out powerful creatures like Phantom Nishoba while disrupting opponents' strategies with control elements like Swords to Plowshares and Duress. The deck also utilizes graveyard recursion with Gaea's Blessing and Living Wish to constantly put threats on the board and maintain control of the game. The mana base is designed to support the deck's powerful spells and enable consistent plays throughout the game.

The deck revolves around assembling a relentless horde of Goblins to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays. Utilizing cards like Goblin Lackey to cheat Goblins into play, along with efficient creatures and burn spells, it capitalizes on speed and tempo. The deck aims to flood the board with cheap creatures and use tribal synergies to push through damage and secure a quick victory. With an emphasis on early aggression and creature presence, it aims to keep the pressure on the opponent from the start of the game.

The main focus of this Aggro Sligh deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy. By playing low-cost, high-damage creatures like Mogg Fanatic, Jackal Pup, and Grim Lavamancer, combined with powerful burn spells like Lightning Bolt, Incinerate, and Fireblast, the deck aims to quickly reduce the opponent's life total to zero. Additionally, cards like Cursed Scroll and Sulfuric Vortex provide additional damage and pressure. The mana base is designed to ensure consistent access to red mana for casting spells efficiently.

This deck focuses on using various creatures with enter-the-battlefield effects to control the board and outvalue the opponent. By utilizing cards like Wirewood Symbiote and Quirion Ranger to repeatedly trigger these effects, as well as Survival of the Fittest to tutor out the necessary creatures, the deck aims to maintain card advantage and disrupt the opponent's game plan. With access to powerful cards like Gilded Drake and Flametongue Kavu, the deck can quickly turn the tide of the game in its favor while controlling the pace of the match.

The deck focuses on utilizing various creatures like Birds of Paradise and Wall of Roots to generate mana and trigger Survival of the Fittest to search for combo pieces such as Triskelion and Phyrexian Devourer. Cabal Therapy and Mesmeric Fiend are used to disrupt the opponent's game plan while Intuition helps to find key cards. Unearth allows for creature recursion and the deck also includes card advantage engines like Squee, Goblin Nabob. The goal is to assemble the combo pieces to win the game quickly and efficiently.

The deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures like Mogg Fanatic, Jackal Pup, and Ball Lightning to quickly reduce the opponent's life total. With burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Incinerate, it aims to finish off the opponent before they can stabilize. Cards like Grim Lavamancer and Sulfuric Vortex provide additional damage over time. Price of Progress punishes opponents for playing non-basic lands, while Cursed Scroll provides a versatile removal option. The deck's mana base is optimized for aggressive plays, with plenty of Mountains and fetch lands to ensure consistent red mana.

The main focus of this deck is to combo off quickly with Phyrexian Dreadnought and Stifle. By using Stifle to counter the comes into play ability of Phyrexian Dreadnought, you can get a 12/12 creature on the battlefield for just one mana. The rest of the deck includes various control and card draw spells to help you find your combo pieces quickly and disrupt your opponent's plans. Grim Lavamancer provides additional removal and damage, while Standstill can help you draw cards while your opponent struggles to break the stalemate.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through countering spells, removing threats, and slowing down the opponent's strategies. It uses a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and land-based control to survive until late game, where it can start generating advantage through card draw and incremental value. The deck aims to lock down the opponent's resources and win through incremental advantage, ultimately grinding out a victory through strategic play and resource management.

The main concept of the deck is to use a combination of cards like Mox Diamond, Enlightened Tutor, and Scroll Rack to set up a combo involving Draco and Erratic Explosion. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Humility and Land Tax while setting up the combo pieces. Plague Spitter can help control the opponent's board while the player searches for the combo cards. The deck relies on a mix of disruption and combo pieces to quickly win the game before the opponent can respond effectively.

The deck focuses on using cards like Test of Endurance and Worthy Cause combined with creatures like Nomads en-Kor and Task Force to gain life and manipulate life totals. Survival of the Fittest is used to tutor for key pieces, while Living Wish provides extra flexibility. Unspeakable Symbol can be used to pay life to gain power on creatures, and Mother of Runes and Wall of Roots provide protection and mana ramp. The goal is to assemble a combo that will allow Test of Endurance to win the game, while also controlling the board with various creatures and spells.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly assemble the key combo pieces for the Full English Breakfast combo, which allows you to generate infinite mana and deal infinite damage to your opponent. The deck includes cards like Survival of the Fittest and Intuition to search for the necessary combo pieces, along with supporting cards like Cabal Therapy and Unearth to protect and support the combo. The deck also includes various mana acceleration cards like Birds of Paradise and Fyndhorn Elves to help set up the combo quickly.

The deck focuses on quickly building a board presence and putting pressure on the opponent through aggressive creature plays. By utilizing efficient creatures and ramp spells like Fyndhorn Elves and Llanowar Elves, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent early on. Survival of the Fittest provides additional creature selection and graveyard recursion options, while Call of the Herd and Blastoderm offer consistent threats. Gaea's Cradle boosts mana production to support the deck's fast-paced strategy. Overall, the deck aims to win the game through fast, aggressive creature-based plays.

The deck focuses on using Oath of Druids to quickly put powerful creatures into play, such as Morphling and Phantom Nishoba, while controlling the game with counterspells like Mana Leak and Forbid. Scroll Rack and Land Tax help manage the library and keep a steady flow of cards, while Zuran Orb provides some life gain. The deck also includes removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Seal of Cleansing. Gaea's Blessing helps prevent milling out, and Funeral Pyre provides additional creature removal. Overall, the deck aims to control the game and win through powerful creatures and card advantage.

The main concept of this deck is to control and dominate the game through a combination of removal spells, hand disruption, and powerful creatures like Deranged Hermit and Ravenous Baloth. The deck aims to control the board state with cards like Pernicious Deed and Phyrexian Plaguelord, while also generating card advantage with Yavimaya Elder and Wall of Blossoms. The inclusion of cards like Recurring Nightmare and Vendetta provide additional versatility and options for dealing with threats. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and provide consistency in casting spells.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo pieces needed to use Tinker to search for and play Phyrexian Devourer, followed by Fling to sacrifice it and deal a massive amount of damage to the opponent. The deck includes mana acceleration and card selection to help find the combo pieces efficiently, along with disruptive elements like Defense Grid to protect the combo. The lands in the deck are designed to provide the necessary mana sources in a timely manner to execute the combo effectively.

This UR Control deck focuses on utilizing efficient counterspells, removal, and card draw to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. It aims to gradually win the game through the use of removal spells like Lightning Rift and Spark Spray, while also utilizing powerful card draw engines like Standstill and Mox Diamond. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Urza's Rage to close out the game once it has established control. By managing resources effectively and disrupting the opponent's game plan, this deck aims to grind out a victory over time.
